name: Provider Reliability Telemetry
purpose: Measure provider invocation outcomes, latency, freshness, and record counts without retaining provider payloads or raw error messages.
inputs: provider invocation metadata and a host-supplied invocation function
privacy-minimized provider observations for a company/provider/window
outputs: one provider execution observation per invocation
a scoped reliability snapshot with sample counts, rates, latency percentiles, freshness counts, and failure classes

health_states.healthy: Sufficient samples and all configured reliability thresholds pass.
health_states.degraded: Sufficient samples exist and at least one configured threshold is crossed.
health_states.unavailable: Sufficient samples exist and every invocation failed in the window.
health_states.insufficient_data: The window contains fewer than the configured minimum samples.

metric_definitions.window_membership: An observation is included when completed_at falls in the selected window.
metric_definitions.success_rate: (success_count + partial_count) / sample_count; null when sample_count is zero.
metric_definitions.failure_rate: failure_count / sample_count; null when sample_count is zero.
metric_definitions.latency_percentiles: Nearest-rank p50 and p95 over duration_ms values in the window.

invariants: company_id and provider_id scope cannot be mixed in one reliability snapshot
duplicate invocation observations do not inflate sample counts
conflicting observations for one invocation fail closed
raw provider values, URLs, actor identifiers, and error messages are not copied into telemetry observations
failure classes use a bounded vocabulary and do not contain exception text
provider health is diagnostic metadata and does not change constraints, ranking, confidence, authorization, or routing
all observations and snapshots have authority_effect none
host_responsibilities: supply privacy-reviewed record and freshness summaries
persist observations with company-scoped retention and access controls
define alerts and provider routing policy
avoid storing raw provider errors alongside telemetry
